name: veterinary_clinic_system_011_boarding_checkin_flow
instruction: Replicate exactly what the boarding Runs board does when staff press Check In on the soonest upcoming reservation: take the 'reserved' boarding reservation with the earliest check_in date, set its status to 'checked_in', and set its run's status to 'occupied' with current_patient_id set to the reservation's patient. Touch nothing else.
